title: Require fresh sheet reuse confirmation
description: Require a new operator inspection confirmation, exact loading-procedure revision, and leading-edge confirmation for every partially used sheet preparation attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse preparation is blocked until inspection, loading revision, and leading-edge confirmations are explicitly supplied
Confirmation defaults false and binds the instance state/version plus unique preparation attempt
Changing used positions, loading revision, or leading edge invalidates the pending confirmation
A confirmation consumed by one preparation cannot authorize another attempt

steps.details: Add a serializable SheetReuseConfirmation with attempt ID, instance/version, used-position snapshot identity, loading revision, leading edge, disclosure, and timestamp.
Return structured stale/missing reasons whenever the current instance or selected loading assumptions differ from the confirmation.
Prompt for physical inspection and exact orientation through accessible unchecked controls with clear operator responsibility and focus restoration.
Cover missing confirmation, success, cancellation, state change, changed loading/edge, consumed confirmation, and keyboard-only operation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add one per-attempt confirmation value and preparation gate.
Inspection is an operator assertion, not browser observation or a safety determination.
Do not persist a reusable boolean such as sheetIsSafe.
